caveats: This is one provisional year, with no individual-council accounts. Provincial figures cover Pradeshiya Sabhas only. Published totals, subtotals and components overlap and must not be added together. Capital receipts include loans and asset sales, so total receipts are not a measure of recurring fiscal capacity. Missing entries remain blank, and published totals may differ slightly from the sums of their rounded components.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One 2024 provisional revenue category and council type per reported geography; totals overlap components
notes: Provisional 2024 figures in thousands of Sri Lankan rupees. Municipal and urban councils are reported as national aggregates. Pradeshiya Sabhas are reported for each province and as a national total. Tables distinguish recurrent and capital revenue, their components, and total receipts.
